lines: Jawan hai raat, saqiya, sharab la, sharab la
couplets.en: The night is young, cupbearer, bring the wine.

lines: Jawan hai raat, saqiya, sharab la, sharab la
couplets.en: The night is young, cupbearer, bring the wine.

lines: Zara si pyaas to bujha, sharab la, sharab la
couplets.en: Bring wine to ease this little thirst.

lines: Tere shabab par sada karam rahe bahaar ka
couplets.en: May spring always be kind to your youth.

lines: Tujhe lage meri dua, sharab la, sharab la
couplets.en: Bring the wine, and may my blessing find you.

lines: Yahan koi na ji saka, na ji sakega hosh mein
couplets.en: No one has managed to live here sober, and no one ever will.

lines: Mita de naam hosh ka, sharab la, sharab la
couplets.en: Bring the wine and let even the name of sobriety disappear.

lines: Jawan hai raat, saqiya, sharab la, sharab la
couplets.en: The night is young, cupbearer, bring the wine.

lines: Tera bada hi shukriya, pilaye ja, pilaye ja
couplets.en: You have my thanks, so keep pouring.

lines: Na zikr kar hisaab ka, sharab la, sharab la
couplets.en: Bring the wine and leave the reckoning unspoken.

lines: Jawan hai raat, saqiya, sharab la, sharab la
couplets.en: The night is young, cupbearer, bring the wine.

lines: Zara si pyaas to bujha, sharab la, sharab la
couplets.en: Bring wine to ease this little thirst.
Bring the wine, bring the wine.
